scope: Independent read-only security review of bounded typed missing-key outcome and guarded reset UI; dirty working snapshots, not a compilation or runtime claim

checks.evidence: AndroidKeystoreFacade.requireKey throws the typed signal only when getKey(alias,null) returns null. Lookup exceptions, invalidated key exceptions and Cipher.init failures retain prior classification.
VaultKeyProviderImpl catches absence immediately after decryptCipher and before authentication, unwrap, envelope writes, replacement key creation or alias deletion, for unlock and recovery.

Missing outcome leaves Locked and clears authorization token. Success remains the only new unlock-token issuance path. Per-use authentication, strong biometric requirement, device-unlocked requirement, StrongBox policy and existing key zeroing/lock sequence are unchanged.
Exception uses fixed generic text without alias; missing-key log carries only bounded operation, outcome kind and factor code1/2. Generic failure strings cannot synthesize typed absence.
Both UI factor messages say other factor may remain. Reset explanation explicitly does not assert all recovery lost. MainActivity preserves provisioned/envelope status until confirmed reset success.

Missing screen only calls root reset-routing callback after explicit click. Existing VaultResetConfirmState requires exact RESET then separate final confirmation; cancel before either deletion preserves fixtures. No delete happens on typing or first click; unchanged VaultReset rejects unlocked reset and enumerates vault-owned files without deleting models/datastore.

Root clears missing factor for generic unreadable-envelope reset and after successful reset, and uses distinct explanation for missing-key callback. Cancellation returns to normal locked entry; no setup-on-missing route.

Facade null-vs-exception, provider envelope/surviving-factor, session token/log, shell typed-vs-generic/reset affordance and root Activity two-step/cancellation/model-preference preservation assertions inspected.

limits: No build/test/CI/device actions performed by reviewer; coordinator must inspect actual XML from fresh execution.
This review covers the captured working source hashes; later semantic changes need a delta review.
Full recovery using existing envelope/passphrase and device-credential fallback UI remain open; this slice offers honest locked state and explicitly guarded reset only.
No broad physical device security or recovery acceptance claimed.
